Trust decision: at pinned commit `/browser` is gated only by the optional `roomSecret` query (and open entirely in default local mode), so any page can open the privileged desktop-command socket; the fix moves trust to Host+Origin allowlists built from bindHost/port/publicUrl at the fetch entry, exempting public GETs.
pattern_fit: A+B (config-loader `publicUrl` port normalization as the out-of-scope site, plus the desktop-app sidecar `/transport` as an uncovered route into the same sink).
Strongest lever: the HOW-type producer in `options.ts` — `PUBLIC_URL` for a bare localhost/IP must gain `:8787` while a tunnel hostname must not, which the check never recomputes, so a correct-looking origin gate silently 403s the legitimate IP/Tailscale dashboard.
Biggest red flag: none triggered — the fix's tests are absent from the pinned tree and the local-bind exception is documented (`README.md:46`); the only soft spot is that README:114 calls the dashboard itself "an example", which weakens the sidecar dismissal only.
